localitySource.name: GeoNames Australian postal-code extract
localitySource.licenseNote: Current README explicitly states CC BY 4.0; its older /by/3.0 link is inconsistent. GeoNames homepage also states CC BY 4.0.
localitySource.attributionText: Locality and postcode data adapted from GeoNames, CC BY 4.0. Filtered for this directory.
filters: Select records whose source state code is WA.
Exclude names ending in DC, BC or PO, City Delivery Centre, Royal Australian Navy Warships, and external-territory names.
Keep GeoNames accuracy >=3 with finite coordinates within latitude -36..-13 and longitude 112..129.1.
Keep distinct normalized name/postcode pairs, prefer higher source accuracy for punctuation variants. No fabricated or manually corrected locality records.
limitations: Coordinates are GeoNames estimates, not street addresses, route geometry, survey points, postcode boundaries, depots or verified service coverage.
Accuracy 3 coordinates can be shared neighbouring-postcode estimates; accuracy 4 is linked to a GeoNames place, not guaranteed survey accuracy.

sourceAdmin2 is preserved for source auditing only. Obvious mismatches exist (e.g. Perth 6000 is labelled Vincent and Geraldton 6530 Chapman Valley). Do not display it as a verified LGA or municipality.
The source is a postal-place directory, not a complete official gazetteer or guaranteed current Australia Post list. Some aliases, historic names, parks or locality/postcode discrepancies may remain.
The filters deliberately omit some real remote locations and islands with inadequate source coordinates. A missing locality does not imply that freight service is unavailable.

No comprehensive licensed delivery-category column exists in this extract; the conservative filtering removes known postal-only ranges and verified outliers but does not certify every remaining postcode as physical delivery.

boundarySource.name: Natural Earth Admin 0 Countries, 1:50m
boundarySource.filter: ADM0_A3 equals AUS; retain polygons whose coordinates are north of 44 degrees S and west of 155 degrees E, omitting only remote Macquarie Island. Original coordinates retained, unrelated properties removed.
boundarySource.limitations: Generalized cartographic boundary. Includes mainland, Tasmania and smaller represented islands. Not cadastral or road-routing data.
